notes.title: Price change.
notes.content:
Hello!

Following my decision of not deploying further updates for Hollow Throne and moving on to a new project, the game is now available for $0.99 and will not receive any new features or content (at least in the nearest future). 

I have learnt a lot from what I did wrong during the development of this game and would like to focus on using that knowledge for a greater purpose.

More to come.

Thanks for understanding.

onyon

notes.title: Balance patch.
notes.content:
Hey! 
A small balance patch is now live. Here are the changes:

- fixed a few fps issues and bugs
- lowered most of the enemy health and damage
- added a time-based multiplier to enemy exp reward
- lowered base health of all bosses by a big amount
- added a time-based multiplier to boss health and damage
- tweaked a last section of the game by a bit (no spoilers though)

Happy slashing!
onyon

notes.title: Announcement #2: Clarity & deadly traps update! - beta v0.2
notes.content:
Hey guys!
Another update coming in.

What's new:
- spikes!
- lightning traps!
- laser-shooting-robots!
- new upgrade & stats screen!
- improved enemy AI!
- redesigned upgrades!
- pop-up informations on pickup/levelup
- adjusted enemy health
- adjusted chest drops
- a bit more of the world done, ready to explore
- removed demo ending cutscene

notes.title: Announcement #1: Closed Beta is here!
notes.content:
Hey there!

I just released the first playable (I think) beta update! If anyone wants to try it out, check the mailing list form out for a beta access code! You can find the form on the game's facebook page (/hollowthrone/) or my twitter (@leonyon_  | it's in the bio)

Thanks for being here!

your devboi,
onyon


Patch Notes:

- Added the main menu
- Added the music (menu, temple, bossfight 1)
- Added character selection
- Added expert/legendary skills
- Added a new boss
- Added a demo cutscene
- Basically added the whole game so that it's playable

notes.title: Announcement #0: Game Reveal!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'd like to proudly announce that Hollow Throne is coming to Steam on 26.01.2018! Add it to your wishlist so you won't miss it.

I'm gonna post updates on the development process and listen to your ideas/complaints etc. so feel free to post messages on the community board!

If you'd wish to participate in beta testing process, you can find the mailing list form on [url=www.facebook.com/hollowthrone/]Facebook [/url] and [url=twitter.com/LeOnyon_]Twitter[/url].

Hope to hear from you soon!

Devboi - onyon
